**Short answer:** The *active* visit is the patient's open visit, meaning the most recent visit with no `stopDatetime`. The *current* visit is what the chart is working with. It is the active visit unless a retrospective visit has been selected, in which case that retrospective visit is current. Documentation and implementation both live in `openmrs-esm-core`, and the chart consumes them.

**Documentation**
- The primary definition is the JSDoc on `useVisit` (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useVisit.ts`, lines 32-51). It says the active visit "is the most recent visit without an end date" and that the current visit "is the active visit, unless a retrospective visit has been selected."
- `currentVisit` and `currentVisitIsRetrospective` are marked `@deprecated` (lines 18-28). The deprecation says "current visit" is not well defined outside the patient chart and points to `visitContext` there instead.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/visit/revalidation-utils.ts` (lines 9-16) documents the "current visit" SWR keys (`includeInactive=false`) versus visit-history keys.
- The O3 docs site doesn't define the terms precisely. `openmrs-contrib-o3-docs` only uses "active visit" in general terms, e.g. `workspaces/launching-workspaces.mdx` line 57.

**Implementation**
- `openmrs-esm-core/.../useVisit.ts`:
  - Fetches only open visits with `includeInactive=false` (line 66).
  - Derives `activeVisit` as the first result with `stopDatetime === null` (lines 87-90).
  - Derives `currentVisit` from the retrospective visit UUID held in the visit store (lines 92-95).
  - Auto-sets the context to the active visit, and clears it when the current visit gets ended (lines 98-117).
- `openmrs-esm-core/.../useVisitContextStore.ts` (line 44) holds the manually selected retrospective visit (`manuallySetVisitUuid`).
- In the chart, `patient-chart.resources.ts` (lines 84-94) fetches the stored `visitContext` and falls back to `useVisit`'s `activeVisit`. Lines 156-181 pick the workspace group's visit context from it.
- Chart consumers of `activeVisit`:
  - Banner tag: `esm-patient-banner-app/src/banner-tags/visit-tag.extension.tsx` (lines 14-19).
  - Stop and delete actions: `esm-patient-chart-app/src/actions-buttons/stop-visit.component.tsx` (line 18) and `delete-visit.component.tsx` (line 18).
  - Visit form conflict check: `esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-form/exported-visit-form.workspace.tsx` (lines 135, 168).
- Consumers of `visitContext`, which is the current visit:
  - `esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-and-biometrics-header/vitals-header.extension.tsx` line 50 treats a visit as active when `!stopDatetime`.
  - `esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/postOrders.ts` (lines 66-94) uses `currentVisit` to set encounter datetimes and flags retrospective visits.

**Limits**
- Falkon returned "repository not found" for `openmrs-esm-patient-chart`, so I read the chart from the local checkout. I used Falkon only for the core and docs repos.
- I did not read the full `useVisitContextStore.ts`, so the retrospective-selection details come from the grep match and the JSDoc.
